issuer: the State Road Safety Service (Государственная служба безопасности дорожного движения)
note: Read 2026-10-30 on Lex.uz, the Ministry of Justice's National Database of Legislation, in its Russian text (an unofficial translation; the Uzbek is official). The Law "On Road Traffic" of 19 January 2024 No. ZRU-900, art. 44, grants the right to drive cars of up to 3,500 kg and eight passenger seats (taxis aside) to persons who have reached eighteen, and leaves the exams and the issue of the licence to the Cabinet of Ministers; its art. 10 has the State Road Safety Service issue national driving licences. Cabinet of Ministers resolution No. 116 of 2 March 2017, point 3(б) as worded by resolution No. 178 of 12 April 2022, issues the national driving licence of the new pattern for 10 years from the day of issue. The state fee for the licence wasn't read, so it is null. The identity card is the ids engine's. No exchange list was read.
